title: erigeron annuus subsp. strigosus
intro: Erigeron annuus subsp. strigosus, commonly known as prairie coneflower or rough-fleabane, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron annuus subsp. strigosus may include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-arthritic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenoids. The plant's bioactive compounds are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
